params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first member to return.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of members to return.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter the returned memberships by the membership status.

params.name: resource.attributes.sandbox
params.description: Filter memberships by the sandbox status of the resource the membership is in.

params.name: resource.name
params.description: Filter memberships by the name of the resource the membership is in.

params.name: resource.parent.id
params.description:
Filter memberships by the parent of the resource the membership is in.
When filtering by parent both `resource.parent.id` and `resource.parent.type` must be present. Pass explicit null to filter for resources without a parent.

params.name: resource.parent.type
params.description:
Filter memberships by the parent of the resource the membership is in.
When filtering by parent both `resource.parent.id` and `resource.parent.type` must be present. Pass explicit null to filter for resources without a parent.

params.name: roles
params.description: Filter the returned memberships by role.

items.docs: List memberships of the current user.
